title: Ronnie Knows Love
description: Ronnie reads heartfelt listener letters on the relationship hotline, then fixes every single one the same way: get a houseplant together. Barry fact-checks, then gets steamrolled.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on the love line. Denise writes, quote, six years, and he still won't say I love you back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy fix, Denise. Buy a fern. You both water it. Now you're saying it... <p:0.3> through the plant.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, watering a fern is not the same as the man actually saying it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Tomato, tomato, Barry. Next one. Marcus writes, quote, I keep getting ghosted right after the third date.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Ghosting's a gift, Marcus. And listen... <p:0.3> a fern never ghosts you. A fern is THERE.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, you're telling a lonely man to date a plant.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I'm telling him to date UP, Barry. Last letter. Patricia writes, she thinks her husband's having an emotional affair.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Great question, Patricia. <p:0.3> And yes, you should re-pot in spring.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, that... that was not the question.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So here's the move, Patricia. You both sign joint custody of the fern. Legally, he can't leave it. <p:0.3> Which means he can't leave you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, that is not how custody works. <p:0.3> That is not how anything works.
